W.W. Grainger
sells commercial and industrial safety products, including general first aid and select facility patient-monitoring tools like resident tracking tags and pendants, but
they do not distribute consumer or clinical patient-worn medical devices
(such as smart ECG monitors, continuous glucose monitors, or wearable therapeutic tech).
Medical and Safety Offerings
First Aid & Emergency:
Standard workplace first aid kits, AEDs, and emergency response gear.
Facility Monitoring:
Wearable resident tags and emergency call pendants used in assisted living facility security tracking.
Industrial Wearables:
Worksite safety tech and wearable barcode scanners rather than clinical gear.
If you are looking for a specific type of
wearable medical device
or need an industrial alternative, let me know what feature you need so I can point you in the right direction.

Industrial supplier
Grainger
does not sell continuous glucose monitors, consumer smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or sleep trackers
. Grainger provides commercial
Blood Glucose Monitoring
diagnostic accessories like control test solutions
, but advanced consumer wearables are found through medical and electronics retailers.
